{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Correct assay_batch B values: convert from µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
# Batch A is already in ng/mL, so no change needed
mask_batch_b = data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
data_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] = data_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Compute mean biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final = data_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

mean_biomarker_final"}
